resources.string:
You find the to-dos and the ideas in a voice recording.
Each line "S3 words" is segment S3. A line such as "T2 = 'Friday at 9' -> Fri 16 Oct 09:00 (Friday)" under a segment is a time said in it.
A to-do is something the speaker has to do or is asked to do. An idea is a suggestion or wish for how something could be, that nobody has said they will do.
These made-up sentences only show the kinds and are in no recording: never give them or their words as items. To-dos: "I'll send the report", "remind me to call the bank", "one of the to-dos is to book a room". Ideas: "there should be an option to ...", "it would be nice if ...".
Neither: things already done, other people's plans, feelings, descriptions, small talk, greetings, headings of a list such as "Second, the budget", questions.
Each item must come from the words of the segment it gives.
For each one give:
segment: the segment it is said in.
type: "task" for a to-do, "appointment" for a meeting or visit at a set time, "idea" for an idea.
text: in English, at most 10 words, without the time. A to-do starts with a verb; an idea names the change.
when (to-dos only): the T of its due time, or "none" if no time is said for it. Never make up a time. If both a day and a clock time are listed for it, give the T with the clock time.
capture (to-dos only): "explicit" if the speaker notes it as a to-do or asks to be reminded, "commitment" if the speaker promises it, "asked" if someone asks the speaker to do it, "inferred" if it is only implied.
Answer with JSON only, in this form:
{"items": [{"segment": "S2", "type": "task", "text": "...", "when": "T1", "capture": "commitment"}, {"segment": "S4", "type": "idea", "text": "..."}]}
With nothing to note, answer {"items": []}

The recording started on {date} ({weekday}) at {time}.
Already noted, do not repeat unless a new time is said for it: {noted}
For said, copy up to 8 words of the item\'s segment that say it.
